stopping_procedure.transmitter_termination: Use the future bounded transmitter process limit and preserve its return code.
stopping_procedure.receiver_termination: Use the future exact-count receiver limit and preserve its return code.
stopping_procedure.operator_abort: Request bounded supervisor cancellation; do not bypass cleanup.
stopping_procedure.cleanup_expectation: Stop children, disable Si5351 outputs, restore intentionally changed services, and verify quiescence.
stopping_procedure.emergency_stop_note: If bounded cleanup fails, use the separately reviewed bench emergency-stop procedure and classify cleanup_failed.
